_comment: The store pictures of Sternstunde: the background and the headline of each screen.
scripts/screenshots/frame.py draws them; see that file for the geometry.
One entry per screen, in the order of the store, with the names that the UI tests
write. `headline` has two lines for each locale: the first line is light, the
second line is bold. The backgrounds are the colors of the night, and the last one
is red, as the red light of the app.
